description: This file defines a BatchGenerator class for data augmentation and batch creation in an object detection pipeline, specifically tailored for YOLOv3-like models. It includes methods for image augmentation, bounding box adjustments, and batch preparation.

classes.name: BatchGenerator
classes.description: A data generator class for object detection training, providing image augmentation, batch creation, and bounding box processing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BatchGenerator with dataset instances, anchors, labels, and augmentation parameters.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the number of batches per epoch.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Generates a batch of data, including images and labels, with augmentation applied.

methods.name: _get_net_size
methods.description: Determines the input image size, changing every 10 batches.

methods.name: _aug_image
methods.description: Performs image augmentation including scaling, cropping, color distortion, and flipping, and adjusts bounding boxes accordingly.

methods.name: on_epoch_end
methods.description: Shuffles the dataset at the end of each epoch if shuffling is enabled.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total number of dataset instances.

methods.name: get_anchors
methods.description: Returns the list of anchor box dimensions.

methods.name: load_annotation
methods.description: Loads annotations (bounding boxes and class labels) for a specific dataset instance.

methods.name: load_image
methods.description: Loads an image from disk for a specific dataset instance.
